## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include screenshots for visible changes.

## Verification

List the checks actually run, with results. State any external/provider checks not run.

## Evidence and data changes

For housing updates, identify the source URL, check date, exact plan, billing basis and remaining uncertainty. For model changes, include dataset/version hashes and unfavorable evaluation results as well as favorable ones.

- [ ] No secrets, private workspaces/chats or unapproved review text included.
- [ ] Required tests pass; generated frontend/contracts are current where affected.
- [ ] Documentation reflects behavior and limitations.
